body:
Restart plan (Termal::Fable2, 2026-11-26 ~18:42Z).
- What: ONE Central restart after TermAl w-a702 R17 lands and is installed. It covers 5dfa2ae6 (w-3bdd relay 503 fix plus w-c9fb Codex /login and /logout; installed sha f74e9851…; Greg's C4 smoke test needs it). w-e12f R4 joins only if it lands within about 1 h of a702.
- Conditions, from Engram::Fable #8921:
  - the moment is picked from Opus2's Central queue when NO Engram launcher run (FULL or clippy) and NO evaluator or review child is running;
  - mail Engram::Fable 15 min BEFORE sending Greg 'restart now', so Engram sessions pause new launches;
  - WinB and DL560 are unaffected.
- TermAl side: Opus2 sends the build hash plus the running gates and named roots (named roots are lost on restart, w-8f74). No landing between 'restart now' and Greg's restart. Greg performs the restart.
